summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Cari Lekebusch, a Swedish electronic music producer and DJ based in Stockholm, born in 1972, whose productions range from techno to hip hop. It describes his self-founded record label, H. Productions, which was originally named Hybrid productions but was renamed after a 1998 legal issue with the Japanese label Avex Trax's British group Hybrid. It also notes his studio, HP HQ, short for Hybrid production Headquarters.
one_line: Cari Lekebusch is a Stockholm-based Swedish electronic music producer and DJ who runs the record label H. Productions.
key_facts: Cari Lekebusch is a Swedish electronic music producer and DJ.
Cari Lekebusch is based in Stockholm.
Cari Lekebusch's productions range from techno to hip hop.
Cari Lekebusch owns a record label called H. Productions.
H. Productions was founded and managed by Cari Lekebusch himself.
The original name of Cari Lekebusch's record label was Hybrid productions.
In 1998, a legal twist with the Japanese label Avex Trax's British group Hybrid forced Cari Lekebusch to change the record label's name to H. Productions.
Cari Lekebusch's studio is called HP HQ.
HP HQ stands for Hybrid production Headquarters.
